Subject: Realtime API latency spike & token errors - urgent

Hi Jasmine,

We started seeing a significant latency spike and intermittent 5xx token errors hitting our dedicated pool at ~14:50 PDT. Traffic is normal on our side — QPS unchanged, but median latency is up ~800ms and about 2% of requests are returning 500/502. This is impacting checkout flows.

I've attached a small sample of requests during the window (hypercart-request-log-1001.txt). Can you confirm receipt and share any immediate mitigations? We will need evidence for our compliance team as well.

Thanks,
Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We're on it. Initial triage: we've routed this to Karthik (serving runtime), and Marissa will coordinate status with your CS team.

Immediate steps we applied at 15:10 PDT:
- Temporarily routed HyperCart traffic to the warm-backed fallback model variant to reduce tail latency
- Increased reserved node allocation in your pool by +1 node to smooth recent burst patterns

We'd like to set a short call at 16:00 PDT to walk through live metrics and confirm mitigations. Are you available? Also, could you share any internal correlation IDs (if available) from 14:45–15:05 so we can match traces?

We will produce a formal evidence packet for your audit team once we have a root cause.

Best,

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Cc: 
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime API latency spike & token errors - urgent

Quick engineering summary (preliminary):
- Observed behavior: autoscaler failed to allocate warm nodes for HyperCart's reserved pool during a sudden burst across us-west-2 racks. The allocator entered a warmup deadlock when two allocation tasks waited on the same placement lock; this caused delayed node readiness and elevated request queuing.
- Evidence: scheduler heartbeat gaps (15:07–15:15), prefix-KV cache miss spike, and a small surge in token generation tail latencies correlating with placement retries.

Immediate remediation performed at 15:12 PDT:
- Applied hotfix: revert recent autoscaler flag that deferred placement queue merging (patch: autoscaler-flags.diff)
- Manually pre-provisioned 1 warm node for HyperCart; confirmed node readiness at 15:24 PDT

Next steps (we'll own these):
1) Full trace export and timeline for the 14:45–15:30 window (will include scheduler heartbeat metrics)
2) Root-cause postmortem doc with reproduction steps and delta change (ETA: 72 hours)
3) Triage and test improved lock-free placement merge to prevent deadlock

Attaching current artifacts: autoscaler-flags.diff, scheduler-heartbeat-metrics.png (high level).

— Karthik
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: autoscaler-flags.diff (patch), scheduler-heartbeat-metrics.png (image)
